description: Posts a free Outline key to a Telegram channel, rotates it when its data limit is reached and 24h have passed since the last post. Manager-compatible build of the KSH Channel Key bot v1.4.4 (Buy buttons, remaining-green usage bar).
name: Key Post Bot
notes: FIXED (was GAP 1) — paths: config.json, state.json, status.json and .lock live next to bot.py, derived from the script directory. Works from /opt/bots/keypost/ (Manager) or the legacy /opt/ksh-channel-bot/.

FIXED (was GAP 2) — config/state split: config.json holds secrets + settings only (what the Manager form writes); mutable runtime state lives in state.json, which the Manager never touches. A Manager Save can no longer wipe the current key, counter, or pending key. Legacy merged config.json files are picked up and split out on the next save.

FIXED (was GAP 3) — Outline derivation: api_url/cert_sha256 are NOT required in config.json; when missing they are derived from /opt/outline/access.txt at load and re-derived every run. access.txt is NEVER written. If Outline is not installed, the bot fails with a clear error.

FIXED (was GAP 4) — QR: embedded Nayuki qrcodegen (stdlib-only, MIT) generates the QR matrix inside bot.py; PNG rendered with stdlib zlib. No vendored qrcode/ tree, no Pillow, no pip. QR output verified decodable (zxing) in offline tests.

FIXED (was GAP 5) — version file: the Manager writes bot_version from this manifest's version on install/update; the bot does not need to write it. Keep manifest version == BOT_VERSION in bot.py (1.4.4).

GAP 6 — first key on Start: the Manager enables the timer (Persistent=true, OnUnitActiveSec 15min). Verify on the test install whether the first run fires immediately or waits up to 15 minutes; if it waits, a run_once_on_start flag (app change) would close it.

SAFETY — test installs must use a test channel: the first timer run posts a real key immediately by design. Never point a test install at the live channel. The live production bot on sg3 (/opt/ksh-channel-bot/) is untouched by this Manager build.
Offline tests: 22/22 pass (QR decode, config/state split, legacy migration, Manager-Save survival, access.txt fallback, helpers).
outline_prerequisite: Outline must already be installed on the SAME VPS. api_url and cert_sha256 are derived from /opt/outline/access.txt at first run, never typed by the user and never written by the bot or manager.
runtime: python3, stdlib only (embedded QR encoder, no pip, no Pillow)
state_files: state.json (runtime state: current/pending key, key counter, last post, usage-bar markers, tg_offset)
